title: Determination of Performance Characteristics of the MassPLEX Factor II/V Leiden Test
brief_summary: To establish the overall agreement of the MassPLEX Factor II and Factor V Leiden Genotyping Test with bi-directional DNA sequencing for Factor II and Factor V Leiden.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* suspected thrombophilia
* 18 years of age or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
